Package dev.px.core.command

Class CommandContext

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.command.CommandContext
public final class CommandContext extends Object
One command invocation: the arguments, and the way to answer.

Argument access is checked and typed. The old command interface handed over a raw String[] and every implementation re-wrote the same index and parse guards, usually getting the out-of-range case wrong. Here a bad argument throws CommandException, which the registry catches and turns into a usage message, so a command body can read arguments as if they are valid.
